answer: The vault says who, the ocean says how much, the forge says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. An honest proof costs 177 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 335 of them, which totals 59295 POA. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. I would bet my own seat on Parchment layer calfskin warrant stretched on the drying loft, because each calfskin is a season of stretched skins plus a signed parchment record is public and anyone can check it.
